findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest with a customer-managed or explicitly configured key.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Its private ACL limits public access but does not ensure encryption of stored ledger exports.
The bucket does not configure default server-side encryption, leaving model artifacts without an explicit at-rest encryption guarantee.
The bucket has no default server-side encryption configuration, so runbook content is not explicitly protected at rest.

This object does not set server-side encryption headers and its destination bucket has no default encryption configuration. The uploaded vendor roster can therefore be stored without explicit encryption at rest.
